{{Top|leg}}
The '''Biewans''' were the native [[Human/Legends|Human]] population that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Biewa]]. As Biewa was a backwater world, Biewans had little in the way of excess money, and chose to spend what little they had on clothing, shelter and food rather than luxuries like [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. [[Jarik|"Scoot" Jarik]] was a Biewan.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
